about_the_game:
The skies are beckoning! As a chosen architect, you've been entrusted with an impossible task - to build where none have built before, to reach for the realms of the gods themselves. Your tower will rise floor by floor, each decision critical to your continued ascension or sudden downfall. Through careful resource management and masterful building techniques, you'll unlock the sky's ancient secrets and claim your place among the legendary Cloudscrapers!

In Cloudscrapers, you build your tower skyward by completing quests to gain vital resources. With each run, you earn gold to unlock permanent upgrades that enhance your architectural arsenal. Discover blueprints hidden in the clouds to construct specialized buildings like woodworkers, airship harbors, and temples. Deploy strategic defenses against atmospheric dangers as you climb higher. Though resources may run scarce, your knowledge and upgrades persist, ensuring each new attempt reaches further into the heavens.

The skies are serene but treacherous. As you ascend, raging thunderstorms will test your tower's defenses. Mysterious fungi forests and ancient dark magic may infest your building materials. You might even face a giant sword crashing into your creation if you're not adequately prepared. Countless secrets await discovery in the upper atmosphere, with treasures beyond comprehension hidden among the clouds.

What Cloudscrapers Offers

  • Accessible strategic gameplay

  • Thoughtful resource management and construction puzzles

  • Impactful moment-to-moment tactical decisions

  • Satisfying roguelite progression with permanent unlocks

  • Intriguing narrative that unfolds as you reach new heights

  • Distinct, handcrafted 2D art with atmospheric charm

What Cloudscrapers Does NOT Offer

  • Combat mechanics or violence

  • Complex economy simulation

  • Overwhelming tactical depth

  • Punishing roguelite challenges

  • Multiplayer components

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 | AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560 | AMD Radeon HD 6870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Cloudscrapers is an accessible strategy game blending puzzle and roguelite elements. Build the highest tower across realms by managing resources and unlocking powerful upgrades. Discover cloud-veiled secrets as each construction presents unique challenges in your quest to conquer the skies.
